notes.title: Incel Syndrome Leaves Early Access
notes.notes:
After about five months in early access we are excited to present the first full release of Incel Syndrome. 

We would like to thank everyone who has indirectly or directly contributed to this project. We would also like to thank the people who have provided feedback and constructive criticism during the early access period of the game. Your contributions have proven to be invaluable in the completion of this project.

Sincerely,

lan
S.O.C.A.H

notes.title: Full Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Firstly we would like to thank everyone who has provided constructive criticism during early access.

Over the last months we have been busy finalizing, polishing and playtesting the first full version of Incel Syndrome. If everything remains on schedule release festivities will commence in less than a weeks time. 

Please stay posted,

Kind regards, lan
S.O.C.A.H.

notes.title: Incel Syndrome Out in Early Access
notes.notes:
After 7 months of development, 26 cases of craft beer, 117 pots of coffee, 73 thirty sticks of bubble gum, 4 boxes of Montecristo club cigars, and over 9000 hours in MS Paint, we are happy to announce that Incel Syndrome is finally out in early access. We cordially invite anyone who is interested in taking an early look at the game to come play it. The full release is planned for Summer 2021.

Cheers,

lan
S.O.C.A.H
